## Activity

During October 2018, Central Eye Clinic recorded 168 captures. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading performance for the reporting period. The capture volume should continue to be monitored through routine site reporting so that changes in activity can be identified and considered alongside operational issues.

## Image quality

Of the images submitted, 3 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.8. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, while a small number could not be graded. The clinic should continue to review image capture practice and equipment performance as part of normal quality assurance. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, allowing the problem to be recorded and followed up through the established support process.

## Grading

A total of 19 results were graded referable during October 2018. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This measure should be reviewed with the site’s ongoing activity and image quality results. Maintaining complete records of referable outcomes and grading timelines will support routine oversight and help identify any emerging operational concerns at Central Eye Clinic.
